developmentNote: Corrected portrait readout occlusion by fitting view-space bounds to a padded viewport rather than guessing camera zoom. reviewScope: Internal engineering/model-consistency and browser-viewport review only. Not independent expert, official-board, calibrated dissolution-time, RPM or physical-device certification.
